project.name: Omarchy on iPad
project.tagline: An open path to native Omarchy on Apple-silicon iPads

goal.summary: Boot and run Omarchy natively on Apple-silicon iPad hardware with an untethered cold start and usable built-in hardware.
goal.current_truth: Native Linux has not booted on the reference iPad, and Omarchy is not installed.
goal.reference_target: iPad Pro 12.9-inch (5th generation), iPad13,8 / J522AP / Apple M1

milestones.name: Evidence and safe bench
milestones.summary: Reference hardware, firmware, backup metadata, and offline artifacts are identified; restore recovery is not yet proven.

milestones.name: Native execution entry
milestones.summary: No reproducible production-J522 custom-kernel execution path is established.

milestones.name: Linux in RAM
milestones.summary: The offline RAM bundle exists, but the device cannot start it yet.

milestones.name: Hardware bring-up
milestones.summary: Board, display, touch, Pencil, storage, power, USB, and network work is mapped but not physically verified in Linux.

milestones.name: Omarchy integration
milestones.summary: ARM userspace and a J522 platform delta pass offline checks; no device installation has occurred.

milestones.name: Untethered installed system
milestones.summary: Requires native entry, storage/recovery safety, repeated cold boots, and full acceptance.

workstreams.name: Boot entry research
workstreams.needs: Exact production-J522 execution authority or a reproducible early-boot path

workstreams.name: J522 Linux board support
workstreams.needs: Kernel developers for device tree, DCP, touch, Pencil, power, and Wi-Fi

workstreams.name: Device and build matrix
workstreams.needs: Owners of Apple-silicon iPads with Macs who can run read-only collection

updates.title: Shared-cache parser pass closed
updates.summary: Exact archive, XML, XSLT, compression, and live HID code comparisons produced no native-entry candidate.

updates.title: Wi-Fi service reachability measured
updates.summary: Valid open-only diagnostics found the live Wi-Fi services; ordinary development-app opens were denied and no method was called.

updates.title: Omarchy userspace delta verified
updates.summary: The ARM userspace image and proposed J522 platform files pass offline integrity and lifecycle checks within their stated scope.

hypotheses.text: A production-J522 path may eventually transfer control to a custom first-stage loader, but no qualifying route is established.
Reusable Apple M1 Linux drivers may cover part of J522 bring-up after entry, while iPad-specific DCP, touch, Pencil, power, and wireless work remains.

requests.title: Add an Apple-silicon iPad to the matrix
requests.detail: Run the repository's allowlisted read-only collector on a Mac, inspect its sanitized JSON, and submit it with your exact model and build.
requests.safety: Read-only metadata collection; no reboot, recovery, or malformed input

requests.title: Review one J522 Linux hardware gap
requests.detail: Choose one bounded display, touch, Pencil, storage, power, USB, or Wi-Fi question and attach primary-source evidence plus a falsifiable next check.

requests.title: Privately report an entry path
requests.detail: If you have a production Apple-silicon iPad execution path, use private vulnerability reporting before posting details or payloads.
requests.safety: Private report only; no public exploit payloads
